knowledge_chunks.chunk_text: Pet Policy: Pets are welcome at Sunset Apartments. We accept cats and dogs up to 75 lbs. Breed restrictions apply (no Pit Bulls, Rottweilers, or Dobermans). Monthly pet rent is $50 per pet. Non-refundable pet fee of $300.
Parking: Covered parking is included with every unit at no additional cost. One spot per unit. Guest parking is available on the surface lot on a first-come, first-served basis.
Unit Pricing (as of May 2026): Studio — $1,450/month. 1 Bedroom — $1,750/month. 2 Bedroom — $2,200/month. Prices subject to availability and may vary by floor and view.
Lease Terms: Standard lease is 12 months. 6-month leases available at a $150/month premium. Month-to-month available after initial lease at $250/month premium with 60-day notice required.

Move-In Requirements: First month's rent, last month's rent, and a security deposit equal to one month's rent are due at lease signing. Acceptable payment methods: certified check, money order, or ACH transfer.
